summary: Re-verified iteration 36 fixes on Camo Cash connect/wallet sheet. All 3 previously identified issues are resolved. Connect sheet renders exactly one native Camo Wallet card with Recommended badge and 'Native ZK vault · Groth16-protected Solana wallet' subtext. 'Other wallets · not ZK-native' toggle expands to show Phantom, Solflare, Backpack rows (visible, display:block) each with an Install link; no duplicate originals outside .wgroup. Your recovery key restores everything.' with no stray 'browser' text node, and a clearly visible Create button (light bg rgb(244,244,245), dark text rgb(8,9,12)). Full flow: create vault with 10+ char password -> recovery key screen showing camosk2-prefixed key -> Open Camo Cash -> wallet dashboard opens cleanly. Header shows 'Camo Cash Wallet · HN7E…', Alpenglow tagline badges are hidden (offsetParent null) when connected. Receive tab displays SVG QR and camo2-prefixed address 'camo25SKtAusGmFFmPY7sTko7fHB2WpHCtycX1wHYtbjsBR3VkChgmkpDYXMU1agrUqW2cXW9uopZo1pgdAGBEz4mbpDB6psKt' with Copy address button. Zero page errors (no appendChild/insertBefore). Only 2 console errors observed: two 403 'Failed to load resource' which look like upstream indexer/relayer flakes documented out-of-scope.
